text: XXh: any one-byte number in hexadecimal format.
XXd: any one-byte number in decimal format.
XXXXXXXXb: any one-byte number in binary format.
XXYYh: any two-byte number (always in hexadecimal format).
AABBCCDDh: any four-byte number (always in hexadecimal format).
UID: Unique Identification Number. (I.e. Card ID).
EXTD ID: Extended Card ID (Currently not in use, can be use to incorporate 7 byte UID)
RFU: Reserved for future use. Should be always zero.
LRC: Longitudinal Redundancy Check. Algorithm for LRC is stated as below…
Commands are sent to and are received from Device must follow this sequence.
